instruction: Locate the flight status tracking page on United's website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate from United Airlines homepage to the flight status tracking page. Uses existing evaluator functions (is_expected_url_pattern_match metric + active_tab_info getter) to verify the active tab URL matches the expected flight status page pattern. Similar difficulty to original - single navigation action required.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL via get_active_tab_info, which returns dict with 'url', 'title', and 'content' fields
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly handles dict input by extracting 'url' field (chrome.py:82-83)
Metric uses regex search to match URL against expected pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/flight-status', which is semantically correct for verifying navigation to flight status page
Expected value pattern correctly represents United Airlines flight status page URL
Complete coverage: instruction requires finding flight status page, evaluator verifies active tab URL matches flight status page pattern
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict -> metric extracts URL from dict -> metric performs regex pattern match
No parameter handling errors: metric correctly accesses rules['expected'] for pattern list (proper handling of type='rule')
